propuestas.concepto: Dos elementos que se enlazan: escuela y empresa, unidos por un proyecto común.
propuestas.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a professional logo concept presentation for an existing Spanish academic web application.
Brand facts: "Banco de proyectos académicos" connects the technology needs of companies with student skills and teacher project supervision, with institutional coordination. The audience is students, teachers, companies and administrators. Values to communicate: collaboration, clarity, practical learning and trustworthy coordination.
Create ONE original, highly refined logo concept, not a collage of different concepts. The deliverable is a flat, vector-like 3:2 landscape identity presentation on a pure white background, with crisp edges, generous white space and optical balance.
Consistent presentation: the upper approximately 75% contains one large horizontal brand lockup, with the custom symbol on the left and the Spanish name to the right. Set the wordmark in a clear contemporary humanist/geometric sans-serif visually compatible with Inter, using dark navy #172036. Set the exact name on two lines: first line "Banco de proyectos"; second line "académicos". Preserve the accent on é. The wordmark must be perfectly readable, with considered kerning and restrained weight. Both lines together are the full brand name; do not invent a shorter brand name.
A clean lower strip contains two equal sample zones: on the left, the exact same symbol in solid navy on a very light #f5f7fb field; on the right, the exact same symbol in solid white on a dark navy #0d1322 field. Keep those samples subordinate to the main lockup; no captions or other text. Preserve all structural gaps when using one color.
Palette for the main symbol: dominant blue #2f5bd3, optional dark navy #172036 and restrained lighter blue. Use solid flat fills, no gradients or transparency effects. The silhouette must remain distinctive in one color.
Text permitted: only "Banco de proyectos" and "académicos" in the main lockup. No slogans, concept labels, proposal numbers, watermarks, business cards, stationery, 3D mockups, photography, shadows, texture, screens, seals, clipart, circuitry, financial bank columns, coins or money.
Quality: finished visual identity exploration ready for a client to compare, precise simple geometry and minimal necessary elements, not a rough sketch.
Concept-specific design: VINCULACIÓN. Design an original compact abstract connection mark made of TWO interlocking open rounded-square links. Make the links broad, geometric and precisely interwoven, with an intentional small white common opening/negative space at their junction. The overall mark should feel like two sides meeting to form a shared project, with strong visual balance and an almost architectural junction. One link is blue and the other navy; in the monochrome samples, narrow white separations keep the same interlocking structure legible. This is a confident sophisticated partnership symbol, not generic node-and-line network clipart, not a literal handshake, not an infinity loop. No book, no upward arrow and no cube. The whole symbol should be compact and readable as a small app icon.

Concept-specific design: CONSTRUCCIÓN CONJUNTA. Design a distinctive compact modular mark built from THREE substantial interlocking angular tiles or L-shaped pieces. Arrange the three pieces into a coherent rising structure, with a carefully designed central square-shaped negative space: the project that all parties build together. Suggest collaborative assembly and steady progress through the geometry itself. The silhouette should be architectural, solid and balanced, with a small clear upward rhythm. Use a flat frontal arrangement, no perspective or isometric cubes. Use blue, navy and one lighter blue to distinguish the pieces, while maintaining white structural gaps so the geometry survives in one color. No chain links, no circular loop, no recycling arrows, no people icons, no book. This should feel like an ownable modular identity mark, not a chart or a stack of generic blocks.

Concept-specific design: APRENDIZAJE APLICADO. Design a refined original academic-technology mark where TWO broad angular page forms evoke an open book, but their central negative space becomes a subtle forward/upward pathway. The right page has a simple assertive rising/folded contour suggesting turning knowledge into a real project. Resolve the book and progress idea as ONE cohesive compact symbol, not a book with a separate arrow pasted above it. Use confident generous forms, few elements, excellent negative space and a balanced asymmetric silhouette. Main symbol in blue with a navy complementary page. In one-color samples, the white central separation must preserve the open-book/pathway reading. No graduation cap, no light bulb, no gears, no chain links, no circuit traces, no overly literal line-art illustration. Aim for contemporary academic credibility and practical momentum.
